svg.aria-label: A Count-min sketch counts how often items appear using a small grid of counters: several rows, each with its own hash function. Each time an item arrives, one counter in every row is incremented. To estimate a count, read the item's counter in each row and take the minimum. Collisions only ever add, so the minimum is the closest estimate, and it never undercounts.
